title: A Drop for the Asset
premise: Ivo Iversen, a whistle-blower hiding under four identities in a Norwegian fishing town, receives a call on a burner phone that was supposedly destroyed with her old life. The voice belongs to Mara, the handler who betrayed her team during 'the incident' — and who now claims she's the only one who can get Ivo out before the corporation's cleaners arrive. To board the dawn extraction flight, Ivo must surrender the encrypted ledger she's kept hidden for three years, the one secret worth killing for, to a woman she cannot trust. In the end, Ivo discovers the ledger is bait in Mara's own escape plan, and she chooses to burn it publicly instead, trading her survival for the truth — and finding an unexpected family among strangers who help her vanish on her own terms.
about_author: Elodie Whitlock is the pen name of a former maritime logistics analyst who spent a decade drafting contingency plans for people she never met. She writes thrillers about ordinary people forced to make extraordinary trades.

chapters.title: Four Names, No Sleep
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo. We meet Ivo as 'Ingrid Halvorsen,' counting exits in a fish cannery break room and waking at 3:14 a.m. every night since the incident. A routine errand turns wrong when she spots a man photographing the harbor office. Emotional beat: paranoia as a way of life, and the first crack of dread that her four names are wearing thin.

chapters.title: The Phone That Burned
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo. While dumping her go-bag into the fjord, Ivo finds a burner phone sealed inside — a model she personally destroyed three years ago. It rings. The voice is Mara's. Emotional beat: vertigo; the past isn't dead, it's calling collect. She answers against every instinct that has kept her alive.

chapters.title: What Mara Wants
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo, with a flashback to Mara. Mara offers extraction at dawn from Svolvær airfield — but only if Ivo brings the ledger. Flashbacks reveal Mara was the last person to see Ivo's team alive. Emotional beat: rage and longing tangled together; Ivo hates how much she wants to believe her.

chapters.title: The Cleaner Arrives
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Ivo and the cleaner, Voss. Voss checks into the town's only hotel, politely terrifying the landlady. Ivo realizes her harbor photographer was Voss's scout. Emotional beat: the hunt becomes real; safety was always an illusion she rented month to month.

chapters.title: Old Friends, New Names
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo. Ivo reaches out to Petra, a forger who owes her, and meets Petra's teenage son Jonas, who idolizes the mysterious 'Aunt Ingrid.' They plan a decoy route to the airfield. Emotional beat: warmth breaking through isolation — the first stirrings of found family, and the terror of having something to lose again.

chapters.title: Ledger of Ghosts
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo, flashback-heavy. Hidden in a church crypt, Ivo opens the ledger and relives what it cost: names, payments, the order that killed her team. She also finds something new — evidence implicating Mara directly. Emotional beat: grief sharpened into resolve; the secret is no longer just leverage, it's a verdict.

chapters.title: Voss Closes In
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Ivo and Voss. Voss corners Petra, offering to forget her if she gives up Ivo. Petra stalls, and Jonas accidentally leads Voss to the safehouse. Ivo escapes through smoke and snow, but Petra is taken. Emotional beat: guilt and fury; the price of survival is being paid by other people.

chapters.title: The Trade at the Airfield
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo. At the fogbound airfield, Ivo confronts Mara with the ledger's final page. Mara admits the flight is real but the deal is hers alone — she needs the ledger to buy her own exit from the corporation. Voss arrives with Petra. Guns come up in the dark. Emotional beat: betrayal upon betrayal, and Ivo realizing everyone at this airfield is trading someone.

chapters.title: Dawn Flight
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo. Climax. Instead of handing over the ledger, Ivo triggers its pre-loaded broadcast — every name, every payment, live. Voss's handlers order him to stand down rather than silence a story already out. Mara flees empty-handed onto the plane; Ivo lets her go. Emotional beat: catharsis — the secret detonated, survival redefined.

chapters.title: One Name of My Own
chapters.summary: POV: Ivo. Weeks later, Ivo, Petra, and Jonas regroup in a rented cottage while the fallout makes global news. Ivo retires all four borrowed names and chooses a fifth — hers, finally. Emotional beat: quiet resolution; identity reclaimed not through hiding, but through the people who stayed.
